alt: The filed, redacted Form SC-100 Small Claims filing packet electronically filed on July 23, 2026, against L.A. Care Health Plan.
full_text: Superior Court of California, County of Los Angeles. Electronically FILED by Superior Court of California, County of Los Angeles on 7/23/2026 6:17 PM. Case Number: 26AVSC00542. Plaintiff's Claim and ORDER to Go to Small Claims Court packet in Nicolas Hernandez v. Local Initiative Health Authority for Los Angeles County. Defendant is represented by Clerk of the Board / Agent For Service. Plaintiff claims the defendant owes $3,115.73 based on Knox-Keene network failures and unpaid Conlan claims.
summary: The filed, redacted Form SC-100 Plaintiff's Claim and Order to Go to Small Claims Court packet in the lawsuit filed by Nicolas Hernandez against L.A. Care Health Plan. The packet was electronically filed on July 23, 2026, and is active under Case Number 26AVSC00542.
